In the remaining subparts of this problem, we are not assuming that our design matrix is mean-centered, i.e. we are not using $$	ilde{\mathbb{X}}.$$

Again, assume we fix $$\lambda=2$$ in both models. Let $$	ext{MSE\_A}$$ be the training MSE using $$\hat{	heta}_A$$ and $$	ext{MSE\_B}$$ be the training MSE using $$\hat{	heta}_B.$$

Is $$	ext{MSE}_A$$ is at least $$	ext{MSE}_B$$ always true, sometimes true, or never true?
